name: metupuk-site
description: Static rebuild of metupuk.org.uk, migrated from WordPress with no content loss.

scripts.check: node build/build.js && node build/to-webp.js && node build/verify.js && node tools/webaudit dist
scripts.publish: node build/pull.js && node build/make-renditions.js && node build/build.js && node build/to-webp.js && node build/verify.js && node tools/webaudit dist
scripts.deploy: node build/build.js && node build/to-webp.js && node build/verify.js && npx tinacms build --skip-cloud-checks && node build/prune-originals.js && npx --yes netlify-cli deploy --dir=dist --prod --no-build
scripts.deploy:draft: node build/build.js && node build/to-webp.js && npx tinacms build --skip-cloud-checks && npx --yes netlify-cli deploy --dir=dist --no-build
scripts.deploy:cf: node build/build.js && node build/to-webp.js && node build/verify.js && npx tinacms build --skip-cloud-checks && node build/prune-originals.js && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=metupuk --branch=main
